---
title: "MINI now has Tangled and Codeberg mirrors"
author: Evgeni Chasnovski
date: 2026-11-15
categories: [announce]
description: "New mini.nvim and MiniMax mirrors outside of GitHub, Bluesky account, and blog comments"
---

Hello, Neovim users!

The main MINI projects, mini.nvim and MiniMax, are now **also** hosted on two off-GitHub code forges:

- Tangled: [https://tangled.org/nvim-mini.org/mini.nvim](https://tangled.org/nvim-mini.org/mini.nvim). Tangled is a relatively new code forge based on [AT Protocol](https://atproto.com/) with a design to be "self-hostable, hackable and extensible". It is in active development, but recently reached version 1.0. You can read more about it [here](https://tangled.org/docs/introduction/).

    It being based on ATProto means that anybody who has its account (usually means Bluesky) can already reuse it to interact with Tangled. I.e. no need to create a separate account or worry that the preferred username is already taken.

    A "side effect" of adding this mirror is that there is now a [Bluesky account for MINI](https://bsky.app/profile/nvim-mini.org) which also enables blog comments. Please go follow the account : ).

- Codeberg: [https://codeberg.org/nvim-mini/mini.nvim](https://codeberg.org/nvim-mini/mini.nvim). Codeberg is a more or less established Git host based on [Forgejo](https://forgejo.org/) code forge implementation. It is closer to GitHub in spirit and UI, but operates as a community-led non-profitable organization. It also requires a dedicated account (if you don't want to sign-in with GitHub or GitLab).

::: {.callout-note}
This is **not** a full one way migration. The [GitHub organization](https://github.com/nvim-mini) is not planned to go away and is still the main place for issues/PRs/discussions.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
Standalone repos (like [https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.ai](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.ai)) are not mirrored. Mostly because creating those repos and keeping them up to date is tedious work. If/when the project starts to self-host, they will be certainly present there.
:::

---

The reasoning behind this action is that two-fold:

- There seems to be more and more people who would want to move away from GitHub, for practical and/or ideological reasons. This will give them the opportunity to keep using MINI projects.

- I want to (try to) eventually move to self hosting MINI: Git repos+issues+PRs, discussions/forum, Continuous Integration, website. I currently lean towards the Tangled model, but we'll see how it develops. This is a first step that "tests the waters", so to speak.

---

Thank you for reading. If you have Tangled or Codeberg accounts, please leave a star for new mirrors and follow the accounts. It helps to boost the developer morale :)

Hope the next post will be rather sooner than later.
